equivalent.R1A8-decision-audit-skips-enabled-check: every call of the decision-audit writer follows an enabled check in the same call (acknowledge refuses audit_unavailable before the ledger opens; start reconciliation returns before its transaction), and GovernanceService.audit and AuditLogger.enabled/path are assigned only at construction, so the writer never sees a disabled logger; R1A17 shows the pair of checks is covered
equivalent.R1A16-start-reconciles-without-audit: with a disabled logger the writer's own enabled check returns False, start reconciliation raises acknowledgement_audit_pending and catches it, so nothing is written (the ledger and audit bytes are asserted unchanged); R1A17 removes both checks and is killed
equivalent.P-A21-health-memo-not-cleared-after-writ: as in the original round: the memo key includes the ledger token (inode, size, mtime_ns) and every append replaces the file, so the memo misses after any write; the clear is defence in depth
equivalent.R1L3-no-room-reserved-for-completion: completions each name a distinct earlier decision, so a ledger with no pending decision has an even length; MAX_EVENTS is 2048, and for an even length len+1 > 2048 and len+2 > 2048 agree; an odd length means a pending decision, which append refuses first
